selection: Physical cost only ranks validation candidates after all unchanged feasibility gates. Same per-task settings for all five seeds, fixed before tests. Commit all twenty selections before any test. Never select a best seed or tune on test results.
aliases: initial equals fixed_P0; classical_SDRE equals fixed_P0 on the two linear tasks; identical selected/last models counted once
statistics: Report every seed and every scale, between-training-seed mean and sample SD. Within-seed paired initial-state intervals are distinct. Five training seeds are limited evidence.
scope: Four existing physical bases; not exact reproduction of book acceleration pendulum, cart, visual disk, or all four specialized application chapters. CPU float64 full-horizon model gradients; no new global or nonlinear-domain stability proof.
book_disk: Separate chapter8/9 D-learning numerical study, not neural-M or visual-disk training.
prior_evidence: Per-task objective settings inherited from sealed v3 bounded studies; those studies are development evidence, this is a new multi-seed protocol.
